narrative.value_prop: Make EIA's large self-describing hierarchy useful from the terminal without hidden unit conversions, frequency mismatches, silent truncation, forecasts, or causal claims.

quickstart.comment: Inspect recent California grid measures and trailing baselines.
Create or compare a bounded source snapshot.

troubleshoots.symptom: EIA rejects or throttles a request

narrative.when_to_use: Use for reproducible EIA series inspection and guarded arithmetic where units and frequencies remain visible.
anti_triggers: Do not silently convert incompatible units.
Do not compare different frequencies without explicit alignment.
Do not present anomalies as forecasts or causal explanations.

recipes.title: Compare two aligned grid series
recipes.command: eia-energy-pp-cli spread --route electricity/rto/region-data --left respondent=CISO --right respondent=ERCO --type D --frequency hourly --hours 24 --agent
recipes.explanation: Subtract only periods with identical units and frequency.
